decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the shop shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 5 - The proposal hereby permitted refers only to the installation of the new shop front and does not give consent for the display of adverts. Any advert including fascia, hanging or projecting signs should not be displayed without the submission of a separate planning application.

Condition : 6 - Informative: It is expected that during the construction of the approved work no materials or equipment should interfere with the use of the pathway by members of the public. You are advised to contact the Council's Highways Licensing department on 020 8583 4863.
description: Installation of new shop front and internal alterations on lower floor to restaurant
